$comment: VAPP-106: the size budgets release/size.ts --check gates (bytes; gzip where a browser downloads it). Every entry of sizes.json has one, a little above the number on record, so a pull request that grows the SDK past it fails exponential-ui.yml; a change that shrinks something lowers its budget in the same commit (the ratchet). Keys: npm = <package>/<entry> (minified, the entry plus the chunks it imports), xcframework/<slice>, android/<abi>, crate/<host>/<artifact>.
